entries.title: Show HN: A virtual machine made with Google Sheets formulas (no script)
entries.author: SonOfLilit
entries.current_title: Show HN: A virtual machine made with Google Sheets formulas (no script)
entries.excerpt: In a popular post today[1] the title claims "VM in Google Sheets", but it's actually in Google Script, which is basically Javascript and not an interesting technical accomplishment (definitely a useful educational tool, though). Disappointed, I set out to fix it. Voila! https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1g3-FZBnkDuLqFYOmk457... A Brainf k interpreter in pure Google Sheets formulas. The hard part was parentheses matching, so I think other VMs would be even easier. [1] htt
entries.guide_zh: 不用脚本，只靠 Google Sheets 公式实现虚拟机。
